title: Identification and Exploration of Novel B Cell Infiltration-Related Biomarkers in Endometriosis.
authors: Zhao, Chunyang; Zhang, Shuwei; Zhang, Baosu; Tian, Hang; Yan, Guojun; Zhao, Hongbo
journal: American journal of reproductive immunology (New York, N.Y. : 1989)
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组数据挖掘子宫内膜异位症中B细胞浸润相关生物标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To explore B cell infiltration-related genes in endometriosis (EM) and investigate their potential as diagnostic biomarkers. METHODS: Gene expression data from the GSE51981 dataset, containing 77 endometriosis and 34 control samples, were analyzed to detect differentially expressed genes (DEGs). The xCell algorithm was applied to estimate the infiltration levels of 64 immune and stromal cell types, focusing on B cells and naive B cells. Weighted gene coexpression network analysis (WGCNA) identified B cell infiltration-related gene modules. Potential biomarker genes were screened using LASSO and SVM-RFE machine learning methods. Then, hub genes were validated in an independent GSE7305 dataset, and Pearson correlation analysis was used to assess associations between hub genes and B cell markers. RESULTS: A total of 4341 DEGs were screened and greenyellow module containing 349 genes were associated with infiltration characteristics of B cells in EM lesions, then 12 B cell infiltration-related genes were identified by machine learning methods. Based on the external GSE7305 dataset, four hub genes, of which NR4A1, TNS1, ZNF521, and CMPK2, were recognized as potential biomarkers of B cell infiltration in EM, and all of them were significantly upregulated. CONCLUSION: This study identified and exploration four potential diagnostic biomarkers in EM. The functions of the four biomarkers and the role of B cell infiltration in EM were determined using bioinformatics analysis, providing new insights into endometriosis at the immune and molecular levels.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨子宫内膜异位症（EM）中B细胞浸润相关基因，并研究其作为诊断生物标志物的潜力。方法：分析来自GSE51981数据集（包含77例子宫内膜异位症和34例对照样本）的基因表达数据，以检测差异表达基因（DEGs）。应用xCell算法估计64种免疫和基质细胞类型的浸润水平，重点关注B细胞和初始B细胞。加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）识别了B细胞浸润相关基因模块。使用LASSO和SVM-RFE机器学习方法筛选潜在生物标志物基因。随后，在独立的GSE7305数据集中验证核心基因，并通过Pearson相关分析评估核心基因与B细胞标志物之间的关联。结果：共筛选出4341个DEGs，其中包含349个基因的绿黄色模块与EM病变中B细胞浸润特征相关，随后通过机器学习方法识别出12个B细胞浸润相关基因。基于外部GSE7305数据集，四个核心基因，即NR4A1、TNS1、ZNF521和CMPK2，被认定为EM中B细胞浸润的潜在生物标志物，且均显著上调。结论：本研究识别并探讨了EM中四个潜在的诊断生物标志物。通过生物信息学分析确定了这四个生物标志物的功能及B细胞浸润在EM中的作用，为子宫内膜异位症在免疫和分子水平上提供了新的见解。
